puzzle.hint: A reassuring verse of divine support revealed after the Battle of Hunayn — a powerful statement of tawakkul (reliance on Allah).
puzzle.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَسْبُكَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.
